name: Titanium.Media.MusicPlayer
summary: This object represents a music controller.
description:
A `MusicPlayer` lets you manage and playback a queue of media [Item](api:Titanium.Media.Item) objects.

To retrieve an instance of a MusicPlayer object, use either the
[Titanium.Media.appMusicPlayer](api:Titanium.Media#appMusicPlayer) or the [Titanium.Media.systemMusicPlayer](api:Titanium.Media#systemMusicPlayer) property.

Use the [Media](api:Titanium.Media) module's [openMusicLibrary](api:Titanium.Media#openMusicLibrary) and
[queryMusicLibrary](api:Titanium.Media#queryMusicLibrary) methods to access the media items in the
device's media library.

properties.name: currentPlaybackTime
properties.summary: Current point in song playback, in seconds.
properties.description:
This property is read/write, so you can update the music player's current position
by setting this property.

properties.name: nowPlaying
properties.summary: An `Item` object representing the currently playing media item.

methods.name: pause
methods.summary: Pauses playback of the current media item.

methods.name: play
methods.summary: Begins playback of the current media item.

methods.name: seekBackward
methods.summary: Begins seeking backward in the currently playing media.
methods.description:
Seeking speed increases as seeking continues.

Call [stopSeeking](api:Titanium.Media.MusicPlayer#stopSeeking) to
return to normal play.

methods.name: seekForward
methods.summary: Begins seeking forward in the currently playing media item.
methods.description:
While seeking forward audio plays faster than usual. The speed increases as
seeking continues.

Call [stopSeeking](api:Titanium.Media.MusicPlayer#stopSeeking) to
return to normal play.

methods.name: setQueue
methods.description:
Sets the media queue to a single media item or a list of items. 

Starting in Titanium 6.1.0 you can also pass a String that identifies 
the Media item. This string has to be the [Titanium.Media.Item.persistentID](api:Titanium.Media.Item#persistentID) 
property that identifies a media item uniquely.

methods.name: skipToBeginning
methods.summary: Skips to the beginning of the currently playing media item.

methods.name: skipToNext
methods.summary: Skips to the next media item in the queue.
methods.description: If there are no more media items in the queue, ends playback.

methods.name: skipToPrevious
methods.summary: Skips to the previous media item in the queue.
methods.description: If there are no previous media items in the queue, ends playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.summary: Stops playback of the current media queue.

methods.name: stopSeeking
methods.summary:
Ends a seek operation and returns to the previous playback state.

See also: [seekForward](api:Titanium.Media.MusicPlayer#seekForward) and
[seekBackward](api:Titanium.Media.MusicPlayer#seekBackward).

events.name: playingchange
events.summary: Fired when the currently playing media item changes.
events.description:
See [nowPlaying](api:Titanium.Media.MusicPlayer#nowPlaying) to identify the current
media item.

events.name: statechange
events.summary: Fired when the music player's playback state changes.
events.description:
See [playbackState](api:Titanium.Media.MusicPlayer#playbackState) to identify the current
playback state.
